description: Server schema v2: visuals validator, template catalogue and chooser, classification keys, family prompts and schemas, handler changes, mock model triggers, unit and handler tests. Independent of client features; all later features depend on it.
steps: Create functions/lib/visuals.js: LIMITS, KINDS, EMOJI_DENY, validateVisual(v,{host,allowedKinds}), computeAnswer, matchesAnswer (answerCheck ops incl. pie shadedFraction cross-multiplication).

Create functions/lib/templates.js: TEMPLATES table (choice|memory|sequence|sort families), COUNTS, schemaFor(template,{allowedKinds,count}) with per-request visualSchema, chooseTemplate({requested,cls,fits,recent}).

Edit config.js (VARIETY_WINDOW=3, counts), validate.js (validateGame(raw,{template,grade,count,allowedKinds}) dispatch with defaults reproducing v1, new FIX_CODES, classification keys template/fits/visualKinds, quiz+picturequiz appended to fits), prompts.js (PROMPT_VERSION 2, COMMON + family bodies + VISUAL_DOC, classify additions).

Edit handler.js: parseArgs template (absent/null=legacy, 'auto', 6 ids, else invalid-argument 'template'); loadRecentTypes best-effort; legacy forces quiz and allowedKinds []; 400 degrade on attempt 1; doc fields schemaVersion 2,type,templateSource,promptVersion; response templateNote; logs carry ids/codes only.

Edit mock-model.js with trigger words mockmemory/mocksequence/mocksort/mockcatch/mockpicture/mockquiz, mockbar/mockpie/mockline/mockclock/mockshape/mockemoji/mockpicto/mockthermo, mockbadvisual/mockmismatch/mockdupcards/mockbadsort/mockschema400/mockfallback; honors payload.template/visualKinds/itemCount.

Add unit tests (adversarial fixtures per design section 9) and handler tests (legacy no-visual, v2 doc shapes, override, fallback, variety, degrade, retry/refund, no model text in logs). Keep every existing test passing; update PROMPT_VERSION test to 2.
Commit locally in two logical commits; stage files by name.
acceptance_criteria: node --test functions/test/unit.test.js passes with >= 282 tests plus new ones
handler tests pass with >= 29 plus new ones
A legacy request (no template) stores a doc with type quiz and no visual or answerCheck anywhere
firestore.rules, firestore.indexes.json, index.js, model.js, quota.js unchanged
findings: EXECUTED (observed): unit 397 pass/0 fail (baseline 282); handler 50 pass/0 fail (baseline 29); extra e2e+client with MQ_MOCK_MODEL=1 26 pass/0 fail (unchanged); rules not run (rules/indexes untouched). Commits: a645818 (lib foundation: text.js, visuals.js, templates.js, config, validate) and 0342d01 (prompts, handler, mock-model, tests). TRACED only: Vertex acceptance of the per-request schemas (schemaComplexity cap <=140 nodes asserted), real model quality. NOTES FOR LATER STEPS: (1) New modules: lib/text.js (shared checkText/trimmed/normKey/readingFor moved out of validate.js), lib/visuals.js (LIMITS, KINDS, COMPACT_KINDS, HOSTS, EMOJI_DENY, KEYS, emojiOk, validateVisual, validateAnswerCheck, computeAnswer, matchesAnswer, answerConsistent), lib/templates.js (TEMPLATES, TEMPLATE_IDS, COUNTS, schemaFor, visualSchema, schemaComplexity, chooseTemplate, itemCountFor, hostKindsFor). Client LIMITS/EMOJI_DENY copy must match visuals.js. (2) Docs now ALWAYS have schemaVersion 2 + templateSource (auto|user|fallback|variety), promptVersion 2, even for legacy requests (type quiz, no visual/answerCheck); existing happy-path handler test was updated accordingly. (3) Payload keys: quiz/picturequiz/catch -> questions[{id,text,options,correctIndex,hint,explanation,emoji?,visual?}] (answerCheck never stored); memory -> pairs[{id,a:{label,emoji?,visual?},b:{...},hint,explanation}]; sequence -> rounds[{id,prompt,steps[{label,emoji?,visual?}] in correct order,hint,explanation}]; sort -> bins[{id,label,emoji?,rule}] + items[{id,label,emoji?,visual?,bin(0-based),explanation}]; questionCount = number of items. Label limits: memory side <=30 cp, step 2-40 cp (<= opt+3 words), sort item <=30, bin label <=20, rule 3-60, round prompt 8-120. (4) Response adds templateNote ('fallback'|null) on ok only; refusals unchanged. Request template: absent/null=legacy, 'auto', or 6 ids; else invalid-argument detail 'template'. (5) Classification validator treats template/fits/visualKinds as OPTIONAL (defaults quiz / [quiz,picturequiz] / []) so old scripted classifiers still pass; Vertex CLASSIFY_SCHEMA requires them; fits always gets quiz+picturequiz appended. (6) Variety query runs only for template 'auto' (createdBy==uid orderBy createdAt desc limit 3, uses existing index). 400 degrade only when allowedKinds non-empty on attempt 1. (7) Mock triggers in lib/mock-model.js header comment; bad* and mockmismatch are invalid on the first attempt only (fixed on retry); mockinvalidtwice permanent; mockschema400 throws status 400 only while visualKinds non-empty; picture-kind questions without kinds get inline data ('Cats have 6...') when topic has mockpicture/mockbar/mockpie. (8) picturequiz with non-empty allowedKinds requires visual-or-emoji per question and >= half with a visual (an invalid visual counts as offered, avoiding double errors). (9) Not done by design for this FEAT: functions/README.md docs, index.html, firestore rules/indexes (unchanged), index.js/model.js/quota.js (unchanged). Existing e2e/client tests do not yet exercise v2 templates; later steps should add e2e cases using the mock trigger words.
